title: Differences in the Moral Foundations of Large Language Models
findings: Most LLMs, particularly more advanced and capable models, tend to undervalue the 'sanctity/purity' moral foundation compared to a US nationally representative human baseline. This finding contributes to an overall 'liberal slant' in the models, where they rate violations of sanctity (along with loyalty and authority) less seriously than humans do.
